svg.title: Tencent Cloud Self-Managed Kubernetes Architecture
svg.desc: Repository configuration: one control-plane CVM and one shared DevOps worker. Terraform provisions the foundation. Jenkins, Harbor and Argo CD support CI/CD. CFS provides dynamic storage. Monitoring is optional. Live deployment has not been verified.
svg.text: Current repository configuration · Cost-saving mode · 1 control plane + 1 shared worker
Configured region: ap-hongkong · AZ input: ap-hongkong-2
Kubernetes 1.28.8 · kubeadm · CVM private networking + security group
SHARED WORKER · k8s-node-1 · 8 vCPU / 16 GiB · purpose=devops
DaemonSet · hostNetwork · HTTP :80 · preferred DevOps affinity
Dynamic provisioning · NFS v3 · access group + CIDR rules
Solid arrows: main configured relationships. Dashed: optional or dependent on external declarations.
No CLB / API VIP configured · Plane disabled · Live state unverified · Reviewed 2026-11-08
